scope: Read-only criterion triage of the ten pillars recorded EVIDENCE_READY. No criterion is promoted to COMPLETE; no status is written back to the coverage register or derived matrix.

method.evidence_rule: Only current evidence-index bindings with evidence_status REVIEWED are counted as reviewed evidence. Candidate notes, questions, source counts and lexical matches are triage signals, not proof of criterion completion.
method.recommended_status_rule: PROPOSAL_READY when reviewed material exists but criterion-specific construction/review is absent; EVIDENCE_READY when the corpus has no usable reviewed candidate material and targeted extraction or audit is still required.
method.completion_rule: COMPLETE is never emitted by this audit. It requires a criterion-specific reviewed release, valid locators/provenance, questionnaire and navigation checks, and documented rationale.
method.confidentiality: Only identifiers, hashes, locators/counts and status values are emitted; no source text or project answers are copied.
